 Follow Joe Burrow’s GF Olivia Ponton Contemplating ‘Surgery’ After Being Diagnosed With Health Condition
 Nisarga Barkule Updated Thu, November 5, 2026 at 2:52 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Olivia Ponton arrives on the red carpet for the Glamour Women of the Year Awards on Tuesday, November 4, 2025 at The Plaza Hotel in New York City. PUBLICATIONxNOTxINxUSA NYP20251104557 SERENAxXUxNING ©IMAGO/UPI Photo Sports Illustrated model Olivia Ponton has shared a health update, revealing that she has been diagnosed with an eye condition called pterygium. The model, who has been linked to Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow, took to social media to confirm she visited an optometrist, saying she is unsure whether surgery will be needed and plans to put it off.
 In a mirror selfie with her new glasses, which was later shared on X, Olivia Ponton said: "ps I finally went to the optometrist & got 3 pairs of glasses ???????????????????????? I have a bit of pterygium, aka 'surfer's eye.' I'm not sure if it's bad enough to get surgery, but I'm going to put it off for as long as I can heheheh."
 Pterygium, also known as surfer's eye, is a raised, benign growth of fleshy tissue on the conjunctiva, the clear tissue that covers the white part of your eye. It is non-cancerous and slowly grows towards the cornea of the eye, causing dryness, redness, and discomfort, as per ClevelandClinic.org.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Symptoms of small pterygium can be treated with artificial tears; however, larger growths can cause deformation of the cornea, causing astigmatism. Surgery is typically considered when the growth threatens the center of the eye. In those cases, it is removed by an ophthalmologist, often with a conjunctival graft covering the area. Ponton has not said whether her case has reached that point.
 Olivia Ponton faces a serious health crossroads. Stay updated on how this develops and what it means for those close to her by subscribing to our newsletter. 
 Pterygium is commonly linked to long periods of time outdoors. The sun, wind, and sea can all cause this condition. Olivia Ponton grew up on the coast in Naples, Florida, and competed in water skiing for 9 years. She started surfing around two years ago and often has to go outdoors for photoshoots on the beach.
 "I got barreled for the first time, and that was a crazy emotion to feel…I probably started twoish years ago. I used to like live on and off in Hawaii for like about a year and a halfish two years. I would just like rent places for the winter," Ponton said on the Booked & Busy with Olivia Ponton podcast in April.
 Advertisement Advertisement Olivia has not committed to surgery and says she is putting the decision off for as long as she can while wearing her new glasses. She is also currently very busy with work. Recently, she posted online stating she was extremely tired, sharing that she had taken 8 flights in 8 days, which had thrown her sleep pattern out of sync.
 Olivia Ponton and Burrow's relationship became widely publicized in December 2024. Whilst Burrow was playing away in Dallas, Olivia turned up at his home in Ohio and found a break-in. A report from the Hamilton County Sheriff's Office stated that Olivia found the broken window and called 911, which caused lots of rumors.
 Throughout the year, they have been seen together at public events. They were spotted leaving events together at the Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix weekend, and have attended Met Gala after-parties. Olivia Ponton attended Cincinnati's training camp in August and was photographed talking to Burrow on the field, though neither has commented publicly on their relationship.
